title: AI receptionist for US dental clinics' missed calls

source.text: An AI receptionist that answers missed calls for US dental clinics and books appointments, $199/month. Just go: launch country US, budget $2,000, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Do not ask questions.

problem: US dental clinics miss calls and lose appointments
solution: An AI receptionist that answers missed calls and books appointments
claims: answers missed calls for US dental clinics
assumptions: Customer narrowed to independent 1-3 location general practices (not DSOs)
Booking means writing into the practice management system (PMS), starting with Open Dental
Founder time valued at $50/hour for CAC
~200 handled calls x 2.5 minutes per clinic per month
